  <rights>2026 DW</rights>

  <title><![CDATA[Brazil: Amazon deforestation lowest in nearly 40 years]]></title>

  <published>2026-10-16T22:30:00Z</published>
  <rights>2026 DW</rights>
  <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://www.dw.com/en/brazil-amazon-deforestation-lowest-in-nearly-40-years/a-79684906?maca=en-rss-en-top-1022-xml-atom"/>

  <title><![CDATA[Hijab ban at schools in Azerbaijan: What's behind the rare wave of protests?]]></title>

  <published>2026-10-16T17:46:00Z</published>
  <rights>2026 DW</rights>
  <link rel="alternate" hreflang="en" href="https://www.dw.com/en/hijab-ban-at-schools-in-azerbaijan-what-s-behind-the-rare-wave-of-protests/a-79683716?maca=en-rss-en-top-1022-xml-atom"/>
